#Including the Art Deco District, Ocean Drive, Downtown Miami, Brickell Avenue, Little Havana,

##Duration
This tour lasts between three and eight hours depending on the amount hop on to Discover and hop off to explore.

##About
See Miami from a totally different and refreshing perspective, from the water. This fun four-hour city tour and boat cruise takes you through the streets of the dynamic city, and through the waters around it. Learn about the History of Miami, and get a great glance of this magical city. After the cruise, enjoy the complimentary 3 hours  bike rental to explore South Beach on any date of your choosing.
Start by getting picked up at our shop in South Beach, or at our shop, and ride around town in a comfortable air-conditioned bus. See some of the most scenic spots, including the Art Deco District, Ocean Drive, Downtown Miami, Brickell Avenue, Little Havana, and Calle Ocho. 

After exploring the city by land, hit the water with a fully narrated sightseeing boat cruise. Cruise through Biscayne Bay, see the Downtown Miami skyline, the Port of Miami, Fisher Island, and Millionaire’s Row. Purchase beverages and light snacks on board during the 90-minute cruise. 
Finally, explore South Beach by bicycle, an excellent way to see Miami Beach even further. Ride through glamorous SoBe, and experience a tropical paradise. Ride past the Versace Mansion, Star Island, the vibrant Lincoln Road outdoor mall, Ocean Drive and the Art Deco District, South Pointe Park and more.
